newsitem.title: UK: UK shares fall from Friday's record as Dow drops.
newsitem.headline: UK shares fall from Friday's record as Dow drops.

text.p: UK shares retreated on Monday from Friday's record close as Wall Street also fell from last week's peaks, with markets cautious ahead of Tuesday's senate testimony by Federal Reserve chief Alan Greenspan.
Amid selective profit-taking in stocks such as Pearson which led last week's record-breaking run, the FTSE 100 index closed 13.7 points lower at 4,194.0 with decliners in a near two-to-one majority.
With the UK market due a pause after last week's gains, dealers said there was concern Greenspan could return to his December warning over "irrational exuberance" in markets.
